sn45.49:1.2: Suriyassa bhikkhave udayato etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittaṃ yad idam aruṇuggaṃ ||
sn45.49:1.3: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa uppādāya etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittaṃ yad idam kalyāṇamittatā || || 3.
sn45.49:1.4: Kalyāṇamittassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkham ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvessati a- a- maggam bahulīkarissati || ||
sn45.49:1.5: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkaroti || || 4.
sn45.49:1.6: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || ||
sn45.49:1.7: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyānamitto ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti a- abahulīkarotī ti || || 2.
